description: This file contains React hooks for integrating with react-three-fiber, including hooks for accessing internal state, managing loaders, and handling 3D objects and assets.

methods.name: useInstanceHandle
methods.description: Provides a reference to an internal Instance object for a React ref, allowing access to react-internal fields.

methods.name: useStore
methods.description: Returns the react-three-fiber Zustand store for state management within the Canvas.

methods.name: useThree
methods.description: Accesses R3F's internal state, such as renderer, scene, and camera, with optional selection and equality comparison.

methods.name: useFrame
methods.description: Executes a callback before each render in the shared frame loop, with optional render priority.

methods.name: useGraph
methods.description: Builds and returns a node graph of a THREE.Object3D, including named nodes and materials.

methods.name: useLoader
methods.description: Synchronous hook to load and cache assets with a three.js loader, requires Suspense boundary.
